result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: poll_feed.rb processes `rss.items.each` with no rescue; `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError on nil content, and TopicEmbed#import's `url =~ /^https?:\/\//` guard does not ensure URI(url) in absolutize_urls parses (spaces raise URI::InvalidURIError). With `sidekiq_options retry: false`, one malformed item permanently blocks later items on hourly runs.

judged_text: The rss.items loop has no per-item error handling, and two crash triggers pass the existing guards: an item without content (`nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError) and a link that satisfies import's `^https?\://` regex but fails URI parsing inside absolutize_urls (URI::InvalidURIError, e.g. a space in the path). One malformed feed item aborts the entire import at that point, and because items are processed in order with retry disabled, every feed item after it is never imported on any future hourly run — feed polling is permanently stuck.
